theme: job ticket UUID URLENC JSONESC CRC32 CLAIM mint

weaknesses.title: CRC32 / HASH / HEX stamp trio confuses integrity semantics
weaknesses.detail: CRC32 IEEE 8-hex, HASH FNV 8-hex, HEX full payload all look like digests. Agents pick wrong algo for audit vs change-detect vs transport.
weaknesses.repro: CRC32 vs HASH of same string differ; both length 8

weaknesses.title: URLDEC treats + as space (form-style) — path false friend
weaknesses.detail: a+b decodes to a b. Path leaves with literal + break. Encode uses %20 for space not +. Asymmetric form vs RFC path expectations.

weaknesses.title: Encode family sprawl: URLENC HEX BASE64 JSONESC without FILE variants
weaknesses.detail: String plane only; no URLENCFILE/CRC-of-stream for binary. Continues encode sprawl.

weaknesses.title: CLAIM body and ACTIVE meta omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: worker=alpha glued; ACTIVE path glued to total in cat -A.

weaknesses.title: JSONESC escapes solidus as \/ — agents may over-escape paths
weaknesses.detail: a/b → a\/b. Valid JSON but surprises path round-trips if not unescaped.

weaknesses.title: UUID vs UUID0 dual length 36/32 without path-safe guarantee for all FS
weaknesses.detail: Compact is hex-only good; dashed needs care as leaf. No UUID-as-filename helper.

weaknesses.title: Mint reuses CLAIM orphan/wedge semantics
weaknesses.detail: Crash after mint leaves orphan ticket; no reclaim.

workarounds: Document CRC for interop, HASH for cheap local, EQFILE for equality
Prefer %20 only; avoid + in path leaves
JSONUNESC before using jesc output as path text
UUID0 for ticket filenames under root
Digit-check REQUIRE; RM orphan tickets on GC
